description: For a buyer who posts the same upkeep again and again (a building kept clean, a lot kept clear), this says where that upkeep stands. Pass the buyer's wallet and the exact title of the upkeep. It reads only that wallet's own public list of posted jobs and answers four things: the last visit that was accepted, the visits still open, the visits that lapsed because nobody claimed them, and the next due date. The next due date is arithmetic on your own list: the newest visit's posted date plus the cadence in days, which you pass or which the newest visit states. It is not a promise. Nothing is signed, posted, sent or scheduled. Vealth is not a party: it does not schedule visits, does not post for you, does not remind anyone and does not promise that a worker will come. If the board does not answer, it says so and gives no figures. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

cadenceDays.description: Optional. Days between visits. When it is left out, the newest visit's own text is read for 'repeated every N days'.

title.description: The exact title of the upkeep, as posted. Up to 200 characters. A series is its exact title.

wallet.description: The 0x address of the wallet that posted the visits. Address only, never a private key.
